title: TerminalWorld (EuniAI)
input: Asciinema recordings and associated metadata accepted by the upstream filters.

execution.model: native Haiku and Sonnet helpers; claude-sonnet-4-6 author/refiner

conversion.approach: Keep native Harbor tasks; make runtime configuration explicit and preserve reconstruction evidence.

deviations: Restored commands_with_output omitted by the upstream stage serializer and normalized extracted command strings; original scorer prompts/thresholds unchanged
Preserved released skills under paths expected by the native agent launcher; IS_SANDBOX=1 in remote VM
Restored exact Docker COPY asset moved out of the build context by native cleanup
Native builder adapted an unavailable historical data URL using another NASA URL already present in metadata
Original refiner reached its 40-turn cap after reference/no-op success; native --repair completed under a 60-turn/$3 cap
Recorded agent-side Harbor Trial API compatibility fix; final export rebuilt before validation
known_limitations: Use the recording-derived project. Record missing state and weak status-file checks as findings, without redesigning the verifier during baseline reproduction.

why_this_order: Native Harbor output, but source-state reconstruction is less predictable; tackle it after container execution is established.
